Passkey engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple's passkey workflow covers storefront language. Developer portal, Xcode, and Connect actually separate login behavior from product-page copy:

  • Passkey credential provider — ASAuthorizationPlatformPublicKeyCredentialProvider and registration flows in the binary. Controls whether the app can create and use passkeys. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Associated Domains & Relying Party ID — configured in Apple Developer and your web server (apple-app-site-association). Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains passwordless sign-in to buyers.
  • WebAuthn server attestation — challenge generation, credential verification, and account linking on your backend. Your listing may mention passwordless login; implementing attestation is engineering work, not listing copy.
  • iCloud Keychain passkey sync — system-level sync of passkeys across Apple devices. Listing copy may reference it as a buyer benefit; configuring sync is platform behavior, not Connect metadata.
  • Face ID / Touch ID unlock — LocalAuthentication may gate passkey use on device. Mentioning "Unlock with Face ID to use a passkey" on screenshots is listing marketing — AppLocale does not implement LocalAuthentication or write a separate Face ID listing page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of passkey capability flags.

A working passkey integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Passkey-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Passkey-centric listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe passwordless login — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Passkey phrasing

US pages use "Sign in with a passkey", "Create a passkey", or "Passwordless login." Chinese storefront readers search and scan for 通行密钥, 密码钥匙, 无密码登录, and 用通行密钥登录. AppLocale aligns phrasing with how buyers actually type and read passkey features — not inventing login capabilities your app does not support.

Biometric unlock mentions

Screenshot overlays may reference Face ID or Touch ID as the unlock step before a passkey is used — "Unlock with Face ID to use a passkey." Chinese buyers expect concise 面容 ID 解锁 or 触控 ID 解锁 phrasing in listing copy. These are factual product claims on the product page — not substitutes for LocalAuthentication engineering, which AppLocale does not implement.

iCloud Keychain passkey sync

Some listings mention passkeys syncing across iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud Keychain. This is distinct from CloudKit app-data sync covered on our iCloud sync guide. Listing copy may reference 通行密钥跨设备同步 as a buyer benefit — not as a ranking claim.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need passkey-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 通行密钥, 无密码登录, and 密码钥匙 each signal different intent from generic productivity keywords or Sign in with Apple terms.

Common mistakes on Passkey zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming passkey integration localizes automatically — credential provider enabled; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and screenshot caption lines still English
  • Reusing US passkey badges verbatim — Latin "Sign in with a passkey" badges on zh-Hans screenshots signal an unfinished localization
  • Conflating passkeys with Sign in with Apple — description mentions Continue with Apple when the app actually sells passkey login; see Sign in with Apple listing (zh-Hans) for that separate story
  • Conflating iCloud Keychain passkey sync with CloudKit sync — listing copy about app-data sync belongs on the iCloud sync guide, not passkey login marketing
  • Translating the in-app button label only — passkey sheet may show Chinese from system UI while the App Store product page stays English
  • Ignoring caption fields per localization — zh-Hans screenshot set uploaded but overlay text fields never saved; see Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese
  • Expecting AppLocale to configure Associated Domains — Relying Party IDs, apple-app-site-association, and WebAuthn server attestation are outside listing rewrite
